items.title: 六状态 Todo 生命周期
items.statement: Todo 资源只使用 not_started | in_progress | interrupted | pending_action | completed | cancelled；not_started 仅表示从未启动，Todo 一旦启动不得回退，Bot->Bot 阶段切换保持 in_progress。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: Bot/Human 阶段与待处理原因
items.statement: 模板阶段支持 stage_kind=bot|human；Human stage 激活或 Runtime/领域服务判定 Bot execution blocked 时 Todo 为 pending_action，并分别记录 planned_human_stage | blocked；Human->Bot 推进后为 in_progress。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap. Slice 1 implementation is bound; later slices still provide lifecycle/persistence/UI completion and final AC verification.

items.title: 不可变模板版本与参与角色绑定
items.statement: 模板拥有不可变 published version、参与角色 schema、有序阶段和可选门禁；Todo 创建时固定 template_version_id、补齐所有 required binding，并快照解析后的 executor/owner；后续模板修改不得影响已创建 Todo。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap. Slice 1 implementation is bound; later slices still provide lifecycle/persistence/UI completion and final AC verification.

items.title: Human 阶段授权与幂等完成
items.statement: 只有当前 Human stage 绑定的 executor 能通过阶段 complete 命令推进；请求必须具备幂等键，重复请求不得重复推进，错误 actor、旧 stage 或迟到请求必须拒绝。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: Execution 完成、恢复、中断与取消
items.statement: Bot 通过现有产物接口和 /complete 提交 execution 完成内容；阶段状态由 Backend 根据 execution 结果和 Runtime 内部事件投影。failed 仅是 attempt 结果，自动恢复期间 Todo 保持 in_progress，恢复耗尽后才为 interrupted；当前阶段负责人或 Space Admin 可带原因 resume/cancel，completed/cancelled 默认不可恢复。Bot 不直接调用阶段 outcome 接口。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: 确定性硬产物门禁
items.statement: 阶段可不配置门禁；若配置，只有 capability registry 支持的 artifact_type + artifact_state 可发布，并在阶段完成事务中校验。V1 支持 pull_request:created，要求当前阶段存在可信上报的规范化 PR 产物事实；未知门禁或缺失产物不得推进。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap. Slice 1 implementation is bound; later slices still provide lifecycle/persistence/UI completion and final AC verification.

items.title: 隔离、事务与并发安全
items.statement: 模板、版本、Todo、阶段、execution 和 artifact 均按 tenant/env/space 隔离；创建 Todo、展开阶段、门禁校验和状态推进使用事务、行锁或 expected-status CAS；数据库写失败必须传播错误。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: 前端模板与六状态工作台
items.statement: Todo 模块提供模板管理、模板版本编辑/发布、模板化创建、动态角色绑定、六状态列表筛选和阶段化详情；planned Human、blocked、interrupted 和 cancel 显示不同动作；UI 使用现有语义 design token。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: 兼容契约与文档一致性
items.statement: 新增阶段化 contract 的同时保留现有 /complete、/report、artifacts/object-file 兼容适配，固定调用方清单；OpenAPI/Plugin contract、conformance tests、Todo README 和前序规格的替代说明使用同一状态和术语。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.

items.title: 正式 schema 变更且不迁移历史数据
items.statement: 提供正式 DDL/版本变更，新增模板、版本、阶段实例和语义产物字段；不编写历史 Todo 语义迁移，发布说明明确旧数据清理、前滚和回滚顺序。
items.notes: Confirmed by the user discussion and aligned to both bound Dima work items before Phase 0 bootstrap.
